spans.s: प्र-˚तोद॑ m. a goad or long whip, AV. &c. &c. (also -यष्टि f., Divyāv.)
sg. (with अङ्गिरसाम्) and du. (with कश्यपस्य), N. of Sāmans, ĀrṣBr.
प्र-˚तोद—यष्टि f., a goad or long whip, Divyāv.
प्र-˚तोष m. ‘gratification’, N. of one of the 12 sons of Manu Svāyambhuva, BhP.
a broad way, principal road through a town or village (ifc. ˚लीक), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a kind of bandage applied to the neck or to the penis, Suśr.
